sources.snippet: ToastyPigeon/gemma-4-12b-full-cpt-itvec is a 12 billion parameter model derived from the google/gemma-4-12b base. It integrates a full-CPT (Continual Pre-Training) merge with an instruct task vector to achieve a unique blend of capabilities.
